name: Zhejiang Hengtong Holding Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Hengtong Holding Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electrolytic copper foil, veterinary drugs, and animal feed additive products in China and internationally. The company offers electronic and lithium battery copper foil for use in integrated circuit boards, lithium battery electrodes, and other products, as well as amino acid products.
